scope: Baseline heads identify the checked-out branch; sourceFiles hashes identify actual bytes read. All tracked HTML/JavaScript browser-source candidates across Site and Lessons; source census, not proof every path is published. Tools, tests, documentation, reports and vendored libraries are separately inventoried and excluded by use site.

rules.writes: First argument of resolved localStorage/sessionStorage setItem or removeItem call; never matching key names or values.
rules.reads: First argument of resolved getItem call, separate from writes.
rules.owners: Source file owner, except canonical maker-splash script equality and three explicitly reviewed reading-theme sources plus two legacy-account sources. Those use sites belong to named components. The Rally hook source and its exactly matching marked inline region have one game owner. Independent game whole-container writers remain distinct owners.
rules.prefix: Strict mbm_ prefix, case-sensitive. Legacy estate namespaces are listed separately and never folded into this count.
rules.profileWipe: null means unmeasured; no common estate reset contract inferred.
rules.survival: Neither this tool nor the registry reads or writes pupil data.
